title: Merge Dictionaries
description:
Given:
```python
d1 = {"a": 1, "b": 2, "c": 3}
d2 = {"b": 20, "c": 30, "d": 40}
```
Merge them into one dictionary where `d2` values win on conflicts. Print the merged dictionary sorted by key, one entry per line in the format `key:value`.

**Expected output:**
```
a:1
b:20
c:30
d:40
```
hint: Start with merged = {**d1, **d2} or merged = d1.copy(); merged.update(d2). Then loop over sorted(merged.keys()).
